橫跨脛骨與腓骨下端、位於踝關節上方的橫帶
supply: Binds down the tendons of tibialis anterior, extensor hallucis longus, extensor digitorum longus and fibularis tertius
把脛前肌、伸拇長肌、伸趾長肌與第三腓骨肌的肌腱固定在原位
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-166.name: Right inferior extensor retinaculum of foot
course: A Y-shaped band over the front of the ankle and dorsum of the foot, attached laterally to the calcaneus
位於踝前與足背、外側附著於跟骨的 Y 形帶
supply: Holds the extensor tendons close to the ankle and foot
把伸肌腱固定在踝與足背
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-167.name: Right flexor retinaculum of ankle
course: A band from the medial malleolus to the medial surface of the calcaneus, roofing the tarsal tunnel
由內踝連到跟骨內側面、構成跗隧道頂部的帶
supply: Holds the tendons of tibialis posterior, flexor digitorum longus and flexor hallucis longus and the tibial nerve and posterior tibial vessels against the ankle
把脛後肌、屈趾長肌、屈拇長肌肌腱及脛神經、脛後血管固定在踝後內側
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-168.name: Right superior fibular retinaculum
course: A band from the back of the lateral malleolus to the lateral surface of the calcaneus
由外踝後方連到跟骨外側面的帶
supply: Holds the tendons of fibularis longus and brevis behind the lateral malleolus
把腓骨長肌與短肌腱固定在外踝後方
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-169.name: Right inferior fibular retinaculum
course: A band on the lateral surface of the calcaneus, continuous above with the inferior extensor retinaculum
位於跟骨外側面，上方與伸肌下支持帶相連
supply: Binds the fibularis tendons to the calcaneus below the lateral malleolus
把腓骨肌腱固定在外踝下方的跟骨上
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-170.name: Left extensor retinaculum of wrist
origin: Radial side: lateral margin of the distal radius; ulnar side: styloid process of the ulna, triquetrum and pisiform
橈側：橈骨遠端外側緣；尺側：尺骨莖突、三角骨與豌豆骨
course: A broad band across the back of the wrist, from the lateral edge of the radius to the ulnar styloid, triquetrum and pisiform
橫跨腕背的寬帶，由橈骨外側緣連到尺骨莖突、三角骨與豌豆骨
supply: Binds down the extensor tendons in six compartments so they do not bowstring when the wrist extends
把伸肌腱固定在六個腔室內，伸腕時不致弓弦狀突起
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-171.name: Left superior transverse scapular ligament
course: A thin band across the suprascapular notch, from its medial edge to the base of the coracoid process
橫跨肩胛上切跡的薄帶，由切跡內緣連到喙突基部
supply: Converts the notch into a foramen: the suprascapular nerve passes below it and the suprascapular artery above it
把切跡變成孔：肩胛上神經走在其下方，肩胛上動脈走在其上方
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-172.name: Left axillary sheath
course: A tube of fascia that continues the prevertebral fascia of the neck into the axilla
頸部椎前筋膜延伸到腋窩所形成的筋膜管
supply: Encloses the axillary artery and vein and the brachial plexus; a local anaesthetic injected into it spreads along the plexus
包裹腋動脈、腋靜脈與臂神經叢；注入局部麻醉劑可沿神經叢擴散
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-173.name: Left femoral sheath
course: A funnel of fascia continuous with the transversalis and iliopsoas fasciae, about 3–4 cm long below the inguinal ligament
與腹橫筋膜、髂腰筋膜相連的漏斗狀筋膜，在腹股溝韌帶下方約 3–4 公分
supply: Encloses the femoral artery, femoral vein and femoral canal (not the femoral nerve, which lies lateral to it)
包裹股動脈、股靜脈與股管（股神經位於其外側，不在鞘內）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-174.name: Left quadriceps tendon
course: The common tendon of the four quadriceps muscles, inserting into the base of the patella
四條股四頭肌的共同肌腱，止於髕骨底
supply: Extends the knee; a source of tendon grafts and the site of quadriceps tendon rupture
伸直膝關節；可取作肌腱移植材料，也是股四頭肌腱斷裂的部位
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-175.name: Left patellar ligament
course: From the apex of the patella to the tibial tuberosity; the continuation of the quadriceps tendon
從髕骨尖到脛骨粗隆，是股四頭肌腱的延續
supply: Transmits quadriceps force to the tibia (the patellar tendon reflex is tested by tapping it)
把股四頭肌的力量傳到脛骨（敲擊它可引出髕腱反射）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-176.name: Left superior extensor retinaculum of foot
course: A transverse band across the lower ends of the tibia and fibula, just above the ankle
橫跨脛骨與腓骨下端、位於踝關節上方的橫帶
supply: Binds down the tendons of tibialis anterior, extensor hallucis longus, extensor digitorum longus and fibularis tertius
把脛前肌、伸拇長肌、伸趾長肌與第三腓骨肌的肌腱固定在原位
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-177.name: Left inferior extensor retinaculum of foot
course: A Y-shaped band over the front of the ankle and dorsum of the foot, attached laterally to the calcaneus
位於踝前與足背、外側附著於跟骨的 Y 形帶
supply: Holds the extensor tendons close to the ankle and foot
把伸肌腱固定在踝與足背
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-178.name: Left flexor retinaculum of ankle
course: A band from the medial malleolus to the medial surface of the calcaneus, roofing the tarsal tunnel
由內踝連到跟骨內側面、構成跗隧道頂部的帶
supply: Holds the tendons of tibialis posterior, flexor digitorum longus and flexor hallucis longus and the tibial nerve and posterior tibial vessels against the ankle
把脛後肌、屈趾長肌、屈拇長肌肌腱及脛神經、脛後血管固定在踝後內側
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-179.name: Left superior fibular retinaculum
course: A band from the back of the lateral malleolus to the lateral surface of the calcaneus
由外踝後方連到跟骨外側面的帶
supply: Holds the tendons of fibularis longus and brevis behind the lateral malleolus
把腓骨長肌與短肌腱固定在外踝後方
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-180.name: Left inferior fibular retinaculum
course: A band on the lateral surface of the calcaneus, continuous above with the inferior extensor retinaculum
位於跟骨外側面，上方與伸肌下支持帶相連
supply: Binds the fibularis tendons to the calcaneus below the lateral malleolus
把腓骨肌腱固定在外踝下方的跟骨上
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-181.name: rectus sheath
origin: Aponeuroses of external oblique, internal oblique and transversus abdominis
腹外斜肌、腹內斜肌與腹橫肌的腱膜
course: The aponeuroses of the three flat abdominal muscles enclose rectus abdominis; the anterior wall is drawn here
三層腹壁扁肌的腱膜包住腹直肌；此處畫出前壁
supply: Encloses rectus abdominis and the superior and inferior epigastric vessels; fused in the midline as the linea alba
包裹腹直肌與腹壁上、下動脈；在中線融合成白線
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-182.name: thoracolumbar fascia
course: The deep fascia of the back over the erector spinae, thickest in the lumbar region
覆蓋豎脊肌的背部深筋膜，腰部最厚
supply: Encloses the erector spinae; gives origin to latissimus dorsi and transversus abdominis (shown here as its posterior layer)
包裹豎脊肌；是背闊肌與腹橫肌的起點（此處畫出後層）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-183.name: plantar aponeurosis
course: A thick fibrous sheet covering the central and medial parts of the sole, from the calcaneal tuberosity to the toes
覆蓋足底中央與內側的厚纖維膜，由跟骨粗隆到趾
supply: Supports the longitudinal arch and protects the plantar muscles, vessels and nerves
支撐縱弓，保護足底肌肉、血管與神經
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-184.name: Right quadrangular space
origin: Bounded above by teres minor, below by teres major, medially by the long head of triceps and laterally by the surgical neck of the humerus
上界為小圓肌，下界為大圓肌，內側為肱三頭肌長頭，外側為肱骨外科頸
course: Behind the shoulder, below the shoulder joint
位於肩後、肩關節下方
supply: Transmits the axillary nerve and the posterior circumflex humeral vessels from the axilla to the back of the shoulder
腋神經與旋肱後血管由腋窩通到肩後方
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-185.name: Right triangular space
origin: Bounded above by teres minor, below by teres major and laterally by the long head of triceps
上界為小圓肌，下界為大圓肌，外側為肱三頭肌長頭
course: Behind the shoulder, medial to the long head of triceps
位於肩後、肱三頭肌長頭內側
supply: Transmits the circumflex scapular artery from the axilla to the infraspinous fossa
旋肩胛動脈由腋窩通到棘下窩
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-186.name: Right triangular interval
origin: Bounded above by teres major, medially by the long head of triceps and laterally by the humerus (and the lateral head of triceps)
上界為大圓肌，內側為肱三頭肌長頭，外側為肱骨（與肱三頭肌外側頭）
course: On the back of the arm just below teres major
位於上臂後面、大圓肌正下方
supply: Transmits the radial nerve and the deep brachial artery from the axilla to the radial groove
橈神經與肱深動脈由腋窩通到橈神經溝
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-187.name: Right clavipectoral triangle
origin: Bounded by the clavicle, the deltoid and the clavicular head of pectoralis major
界線為鎖骨、三角肌與胸大肌鎖骨部
course: A small depression below the lateral clavicle, between the deltoid and pectoralis major (the deltopectoral triangle)
鎖骨外側下方、三角肌與胸大肌之間的小凹（三角肌胸大肌三角）
supply: The cephalic vein runs through it to pierce the clavipectoral fascia and join the axillary vein
頭靜脈走過此處，穿過鎖胸筋膜匯入腋靜脈
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-188.name: Right axillary fossa
origin: Anterior wall: pectoralis major and minor; posterior wall: subscapularis, teres major, latissimus dorsi; medial wall: serratus anterior and ribs; lateral wall: humerus (intertubercular groove)
前壁：胸大肌與胸小肌；後壁：肩胛下肌、大圓肌、背闊肌；內側壁：前鋸肌與肋骨；外側壁：肱骨（結節間溝）
course: A pyramid-shaped space between the upper arm and the chest wall, with its apex at the cervico-axillary canal
位於上臂與胸壁之間的錐狀空間，頂端為頸腋管
supply: Contains the axillary artery and vein, the cords of the brachial plexus, axillary lymph nodes and fat
內有腋動脈、腋靜脈、臂神經叢各束、腋淋巴結與脂肪
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-189.name: Right carpal tunnel
origin: Floor and sides: the arch of carpal bones; roof: the flexor retinaculum
底與兩側：腕骨弓；頂：屈肌支持帶
course: A passage on the front of the wrist, between the carpal bones and the flexor retinaculum
位於腕前方，介於腕骨與屈肌支持帶之間
supply: Transmits the median nerve and nine flexor tendons (four of flexor digitorum superficialis, four of profundus and flexor pollicis longus)
通過正中神經與九條屈肌腱（屈指淺肌四條、屈指深肌四條、屈拇長肌一條）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-190.name: Right tarsal tunnel
origin: Floor: the tibia, talus and calcaneus; roof: the flexor retinaculum
底：脛骨、距骨與跟骨；頂：屈肌支持帶
course: A passage behind and below the medial malleolus
位於內踝後下方的通道
supply: Transmits the tendons of tibialis posterior, flexor digitorum longus and flexor hallucis longus, the posterior tibial vessels and the tibial nerve into the sole
脛後肌、屈趾長肌、屈拇長肌肌腱與脛後血管、脛神經由此進入足底
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-191.name: Right cubital fossa
origin: Base: an imaginary line between the humeral epicondyles; medial border: pronator teres; lateral border: brachioradialis; floor: brachialis and supinator; roof: deep fascia and the bicipital aponeurosis
底：兩肱骨上髁連線；內側界：旋前圓肌；外側界：肱橈肌；底面：肱肌與旋後肌；頂：深筋膜與肱二頭肌腱膜
course: A triangular hollow on the front of the elbow
位於肘前方的三角形凹陷
supply: Contains, from medial to lateral, the median nerve, the brachial artery (dividing into radial and ulnar arteries), the biceps tendon and the radial nerve (deep branch); the median cubital vein crosses its roof
由內向外含正中神經、肱動脈（在此分為橈動脈與尺動脈）、肱二頭肌腱與橈神經（深支）；肘正中靜脈橫越其頂
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-192.name: Right anatomical snuffbox
origin: Ulnar (posterior) border: tendon of extensor pollicis longus; radial (anterior) border: tendons of abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis; floor: scaphoid and trapezium
尺側（後）界：拇長伸肌腱；橈側（前）界：拇長展肌腱與拇短伸肌腱；底：舟狀骨與大多角骨
course: A triangular hollow on the back of the wrist at the base of the thumb
位於腕背、拇指基部的三角形凹陷
supply: Contains the radial artery (crossing its floor) and the superficial branch of the radial nerve, with the cephalic vein over its roof; tenderness here suggests a scaphoid fracture
橈動脈由其底部橫過，橈神經淺支與頭靜脈行於頂部；此處壓痛要懷疑舟狀骨骨折
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-193.name: Right adductor hiatus
origin: Between the oblique and vertical parts of the attachment of adductor magnus
位於內收大肌斜行部與垂直部止點之間
course: The gap in the lower end of adductor magnus, above the medial femoral condyle
內收大肌下端、股骨內側髁上方的裂隙
supply: The femoral vessels pass through it from the adductor canal into the popliteal fossa (becoming the popliteal vessels)
股血管由內收肌管經此進入膕窩（成為膕血管）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-194.name: Right suboccipital triangle
origin: Bounded by rectus capitis posterior major (medially), obliquus capitis superior (laterally) and obliquus capitis inferior (inferiorly); roof: semispinalis capitis; floor: posterior atlanto-occipital membrane and the posterior arch of the atlas
界線：頭後大直肌（內側）、頭上斜肌（外側）、頭下斜肌（下方）；頂：頭半棘肌；底：寰枕後膜與寰椎後弓
course: A small muscular triangle deep in the back of the neck, below the occipital bone
位於後頸深層、枕骨下方的小肌肉三角
supply: Contains the vertebral artery (third part), the suboccipital nerve and the suboccipital venous plexus
內有椎動脈（第三段）、枕下神經與枕下靜脈叢
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-195.name: Left quadrangular space
origin: Bounded above by teres minor, below by teres major, medially by the long head of triceps and laterally by the surgical neck of the humerus
上界為小圓肌，下界為大圓肌，內側為肱三頭肌長頭，外側為肱骨外科頸
course: Behind the shoulder, below the shoulder joint
位於肩後、肩關節下方
supply: Transmits the axillary nerve and the posterior circumflex humeral vessels from the axilla to the back of the shoulder
腋神經與旋肱後血管由腋窩通到肩後方
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-196.name: Left triangular space
origin: Bounded above by teres minor, below by teres major and laterally by the long head of triceps
上界為小圓肌，下界為大圓肌，外側為肱三頭肌長頭
course: Behind the shoulder, medial to the long head of triceps
位於肩後、肱三頭肌長頭內側
supply: Transmits the circumflex scapular artery from the axilla to the infraspinous fossa
旋肩胛動脈由腋窩通到棘下窩
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-197.name: Left triangular interval
origin: Bounded above by teres major, medially by the long head of triceps and laterally by the humerus (and the lateral head of triceps)
上界為大圓肌，內側為肱三頭肌長頭，外側為肱骨（與肱三頭肌外側頭）
course: On the back of the arm just below teres major
位於上臂後面、大圓肌正下方
supply: Transmits the radial nerve and the deep brachial artery from the axilla to the radial groove
橈神經與肱深動脈由腋窩通到橈神經溝
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-198.name: Left clavipectoral triangle
origin: Bounded by the clavicle, the deltoid and the clavicular head of pectoralis major
界線為鎖骨、三角肌與胸大肌鎖骨部
course: A small depression below the lateral clavicle, between the deltoid and pectoralis major (the deltopectoral triangle)
鎖骨外側下方、三角肌與胸大肌之間的小凹（三角肌胸大肌三角）
supply: The cephalic vein runs through it to pierce the clavipectoral fascia and join the axillary vein
頭靜脈走過此處，穿過鎖胸筋膜匯入腋靜脈
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-199.name: Left axillary fossa
origin: Anterior wall: pectoralis major and minor; posterior wall: subscapularis, teres major, latissimus dorsi; medial wall: serratus anterior and ribs; lateral wall: humerus (intertubercular groove)
前壁：胸大肌與胸小肌；後壁：肩胛下肌、大圓肌、背闊肌；內側壁：前鋸肌與肋骨；外側壁：肱骨（結節間溝）
course: A pyramid-shaped space between the upper arm and the chest wall, with its apex at the cervico-axillary canal
位於上臂與胸壁之間的錐狀空間，頂端為頸腋管
supply: Contains the axillary artery and vein, the cords of the brachial plexus, axillary lymph nodes and fat
內有腋動脈、腋靜脈、臂神經叢各束、腋淋巴結與脂肪
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-200.name: Left carpal tunnel
origin: Floor and sides: the arch of carpal bones; roof: the flexor retinaculum
底與兩側：腕骨弓；頂：屈肌支持帶
course: A passage on the front of the wrist, between the carpal bones and the flexor retinaculum
位於腕前方，介於腕骨與屈肌支持帶之間
supply: Transmits the median nerve and nine flexor tendons (four of flexor digitorum superficialis, four of profundus and flexor pollicis longus)
通過正中神經與九條屈肌腱（屈指淺肌四條、屈指深肌四條、屈拇長肌一條）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-201.name: Left tarsal tunnel
origin: Floor: the tibia, talus and calcaneus; roof: the flexor retinaculum
底：脛骨、距骨與跟骨；頂：屈肌支持帶
course: A passage behind and below the medial malleolus
位於內踝後下方的通道
supply: Transmits the tendons of tibialis posterior, flexor digitorum longus and flexor hallucis longus, the posterior tibial vessels and the tibial nerve into the sole
脛後肌、屈趾長肌、屈拇長肌肌腱與脛後血管、脛神經由此進入足底
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-202.name: Left cubital fossa
origin: Base: an imaginary line between the humeral epicondyles; medial border: pronator teres; lateral border: brachioradialis; floor: brachialis and supinator; roof: deep fascia and the bicipital aponeurosis
底：兩肱骨上髁連線；內側界：旋前圓肌；外側界：肱橈肌；底面：肱肌與旋後肌；頂：深筋膜與肱二頭肌腱膜
course: A triangular hollow on the front of the elbow
位於肘前方的三角形凹陷
supply: Contains, from medial to lateral, the median nerve, the brachial artery (dividing into radial and ulnar arteries), the biceps tendon and the radial nerve (deep branch); the median cubital vein crosses its roof
由內向外含正中神經、肱動脈（在此分為橈動脈與尺動脈）、肱二頭肌腱與橈神經（深支）；肘正中靜脈橫越其頂
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-203.name: Left anatomical snuffbox
origin: Ulnar (posterior) border: tendon of extensor pollicis longus; radial (anterior) border: tendons of abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis; floor: scaphoid and trapezium
尺側（後）界：拇長伸肌腱；橈側（前）界：拇長展肌腱與拇短伸肌腱；底：舟狀骨與大多角骨
course: A triangular hollow on the back of the wrist at the base of the thumb
位於腕背、拇指基部的三角形凹陷
supply: Contains the radial artery (crossing its floor) and the superficial branch of the radial nerve, with the cephalic vein over its roof; tenderness here suggests a scaphoid fracture
橈動脈由其底部橫過，橈神經淺支與頭靜脈行於頂部；此處壓痛要懷疑舟狀骨骨折
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-204.name: Left adductor hiatus
origin: Between the oblique and vertical parts of the attachment of adductor magnus
位於內收大肌斜行部與垂直部止點之間
course: The gap in the lower end of adductor magnus, above the medial femoral condyle
內收大肌下端、股骨內側髁上方的裂隙
supply: The femoral vessels pass through it from the adductor canal into the popliteal fossa (becoming the popliteal vessels)
股血管由內收肌管經此進入膕窩（成為膕血管）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-205.name: Left suboccipital triangle
origin: Bounded by rectus capitis posterior major (medially), obliquus capitis superior (laterally) and obliquus capitis inferior (inferiorly); roof: semispinalis capitis; floor: posterior atlanto-occipital membrane and the posterior arch of the atlas
界線：頭後大直肌（內側）、頭上斜肌（外側）、頭下斜肌（下方）；頂：頭半棘肌；底：寰枕後膜與寰椎後弓
course: A small muscular triangle deep in the back of the neck, below the occipital bone
位於後頸深層、枕骨下方的小肌肉三角
supply: Contains the vertebral artery (third part), the suboccipital nerve and the suboccipital venous plexus
內有椎動脈（第三段）、枕下神經與枕下靜脈叢
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-206.name: Aortic hiatus
origin: Diaphragm, at the level of T12, behind the median arcuate ligament
橫膈，T12 高度、正中弓狀韌帶後方
course: The opening between the right and left crura of the diaphragm
橫膈左右腳之間的開口
supply: Transmits the aorta, the thoracic duct and often the azygos vein
通過主動脈、胸管，常並有奇靜脈
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-207.name: Right denticulate ligament
origin: Pia mater on the side of the spinal cord, between the dorsal and ventral roots
脊髓側面的軟膜，位於背根與腹根之間
course: A series of about 21 triangular teeth that attach to the dura mater
約 21 個三角形齒突，附著於硬脊膜
supply: Suspends the spinal cord in the dural sac; it marks the boundary between the dorsal and ventral roots
把脊髓懸吊在硬膜囊內；是區分背根與腹根的標誌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-208.name: Left denticulate ligament
origin: Pia mater on the side of the spinal cord, between the dorsal and ventral roots
脊髓側面的軟膜，位於背根與腹根之間
course: A series of about 21 triangular teeth that attach to the dura mater
約 21 個三角形齒突，附著於硬脊膜
supply: Suspends the spinal cord in the dural sac; it marks the boundary between the dorsal and ventral roots
把脊髓懸吊在硬膜囊內；是區分背根與腹根的標誌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-209.name: Ligamentum flavum
origin: Lamina of the vertebra above
上一節椎骨的椎弓板
course: Yellow elastic bands joining the laminae of adjacent vertebrae on the inside of the vertebral canal, behind the spinal cord
連接相鄰椎弓板的黃色彈性纖維帶，位於椎管內脊髓後方
supply: Resists excessive flexion and helps the spine return to the upright posture
限制過度前屈，並協助脊柱回復直立
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-210.name: Right suspensory ligament of breast
PK-210.zh: 右乳房懸韌帶（庫柏氏韌帶）
origin: Deep fascia over pectoralis major
胸大肌表面的深筋膜
course: Fibrous septa running through the breast between the lobules to the dermis of the skin
穿過乳腺小葉之間、連到皮膚真皮的纖維隔
supply: Support the breast; invasion by cancer can pull on them and dimple the skin
支撐乳房；乳癌侵犯時牽拉而使皮膚凹陷
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-211.name: Left suspensory ligament of breast
PK-211.zh: 左乳房懸韌帶（庫柏氏韌帶）
origin: Deep fascia over pectoralis major
胸大肌表面的深筋膜
course: Fibrous septa running through the breast between the lobules to the dermis of the skin
穿過乳腺小葉之間、連到皮膚真皮的纖維隔
supply: Support the breast; invasion by cancer can pull on them and dimple the skin
支撐乳房；乳癌侵犯時牽拉而使皮膚凹陷
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-212.name: Right palmaris brevis
origin: Flexor retinaculum and palmar aponeurosis
屈肌支持帶與掌腱膜
insertion: Skin of the ulnar border of the palm, over the hypothenar eminence
手掌尺側緣、小魚際隆起上的皮膚
action: Wrinkles the skin of the hypothenar eminence and deepens the hollow of the palm
使小魚際的皮膚皺起並加深掌心凹
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-213.name: Right transversus thoracis
origin: Posterior surface of the lower sternum and xiphoid process
胸骨下部與劍突後面
insertion: Inner surface of the 2nd–6th costal cartilages
第二至第六肋軟骨內面
action: 下壓肋軟骨（微弱的呼氣作用）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-214.name: Right subcostal muscles
origin: Inner surface of the lower ribs near their angles
下位肋骨角附近的內面
insertion: Inner surface of the 2nd or 3rd rib below, in the same direction as the innermost intercostals
下方第二或第三條肋骨的內面，方向與最內肋間肌相同
action: 下拉肋骨（微弱的呼氣作用）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-215.name: Left palmaris brevis
origin: Flexor retinaculum and palmar aponeurosis
屈肌支持帶與掌腱膜
insertion: Skin of the ulnar border of the palm, over the hypothenar eminence
手掌尺側緣、小魚際隆起上的皮膚
action: Wrinkles the skin of the hypothenar eminence and deepens the hollow of the palm
使小魚際的皮膚皺起並加深掌心凹
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-216.name: Left transversus thoracis
origin: Posterior surface of the lower sternum and xiphoid process
胸骨下部與劍突後面
insertion: Inner surface of the 2nd–6th costal cartilages
第二至第六肋軟骨內面
action: 下壓肋軟骨（微弱的呼氣作用）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-217.name: Left subcostal muscles
origin: Inner surface of the lower ribs near their angles
下位肋骨角附近的內面
insertion: Inner surface of the 2nd or 3rd rib below, in the same direction as the innermost intercostals
下方第二或第三條肋骨的內面，方向與最內肋間肌相同
action: 下拉肋骨（微弱的呼氣作用）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-218.name: Oblique fissure of right lung
origin: Surface of the right lung
右肺表面
course: A deep cleft running obliquely down and forwards, separating the lower lobe from the upper and middle lobes
由後上斜向前下的深裂，把下葉與上葉、中葉分開
supply: Lets the lobes slide on each other during breathing; marks the surface of the lobes for surgery
讓各肺葉在呼吸時互相滑動；是肺葉手術的界標
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-219.name: Horizontal fissure of right lung
origin: Surface of the right lung
右肺表面
course: A shorter cleft running horizontally at the level of the 4th costal cartilage, separating the upper from the middle lobe
約在第四肋軟骨高度水平走行的較短裂隙，把上葉與中葉分開
supply: Only the right lung has a horizontal fissure (three lobes)
只有右肺有水平裂（三葉）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-220.name: Oblique fissure of left lung
origin: Surface of the left lung
左肺表面
course: A deep cleft running obliquely down and forwards, separating the upper from the lower lobe (the left lung has two lobes)
由後上斜向前下的深裂，把上葉與下葉分開（左肺只有兩葉）
supply: Marks the boundary of the lobes
肺葉的界線
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-221.name: Lingula of left lung
origin: Lower front part of the left upper lobe
左肺上葉的前下部
course: A tongue-shaped projection below the cardiac notch, the left counterpart of the right middle lobe
位於心切跡下方的舌狀突出，相當於右肺中葉
supply: Has its own superior and inferior lingular segments
有自己的上舌段與下舌段
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-222.name: Cardiac notch of left lung
origin: Anterior border of the left upper lobe
左肺上葉前緣
course: A deep notch where the apex of the heart lies against the chest wall, with the lingula below it
心尖貼近胸壁處的深切跡，下方是舌葉
supply: Leaves part of the pericardium uncovered by lung (the area of cardiac dullness)
使部分心包不被肺覆蓋（心濁音區）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-223.name: Cardiac impression of left lung
origin: Surface of the left lung
左肺表面
course: The large concavity on the mediastinal surface in front of and below the hilum
縱隔面肺門前下方的大凹陷
supply: Moulded by the heart (left ventricle) inside its pericardium
由心包內的心臟（左心室）壓出
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-224.name: Cardiac impression of right lung
origin: Surface of the right lung
右肺表面
course: A shallower concavity on the mediastinal surface in front of the hilum
縱隔面肺門前方較淺的凹陷
supply: Moulded by the right atrium inside its pericardium
由心包內的右心房壓出
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-225.name: Groove for aortic arch
origin: Surface of the left lung
左肺表面
course: An arching groove above and behind the hilum of the left lung
左肺肺門上後方的弓形溝
supply: Left by the aortic arch
由主動脈弓壓出
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-226.name: Groove for descending aorta
origin: Surface of the left lung
左肺表面
course: A vertical groove behind the hilum of the left lung
左肺肺門後方的垂直溝
supply: Left by the descending thoracic aorta
由胸主動脈壓出
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-227.name: Left groove for subclavian artery
origin: Surface of the left lung
左肺表面
course: A groove on the upper part of the mediastinal surface, curving up over the apex
縱隔面上部、向上繞過肺尖的溝
supply: Left by the left subclavian artery
由左鎖骨下動脈壓出
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-228.name: Right groove for subclavian artery
origin: Surface of the right lung
右肺表面
course: A groove on the upper part of the mediastinal surface, curving up over the apex
縱隔面上部、向上繞過肺尖的溝
supply: Left by the right subclavian artery
由右鎖骨下動脈壓出
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-229.name: Groove for left brachiocephalic vein
origin: Surface of the left lung
左肺表面
course: A groove in front of the groove for the subclavian artery, at the top of the left lung
左肺上部、鎖骨下動脈溝前方的溝
supply: Left by the left brachiocephalic vein
由左頭臂靜脈壓出
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-230.name: Groove for brachiocephalic vein
origin: Surface of the right lung
右肺表面
course: A groove at the top of the mediastinal surface of the right lung, in front of the groove for the subclavian artery
右肺縱隔面上部、鎖骨下動脈溝前方的溝
supply: Left by the right brachiocephalic vein
由右頭臂靜脈壓出
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-231.name: Groove for superior vena cava
origin: Surface of the right lung
右肺表面
course: A vertical groove in front of the hilum of the right lung
右肺肺門前方的垂直溝
supply: Left by the superior vena cava
由上腔靜脈壓出
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-232.name: Groove for azygos vein
origin: Surface of the right lung
右肺表面
course: An arching groove above the hilum of the right lung, where the arch of the azygos vein enters the superior vena cava
右肺肺門上方的弓形溝，奇靜脈弓在此注入上腔靜脈
supply: Left by the arch of the azygos vein
由奇靜脈弓壓出
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-233.name: Groove for esophagus
origin: Surface of the right lung
右肺表面
course: A groove on the mediastinal surface behind the hilum of the right lung
右肺縱隔面、肺門後方的溝
supply: Left by the oesophagus
由食道壓出
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-234.name: Hilum of left lung
origin: Surface of the left lung
左肺表面
course: A triangular depression on the mediastinal surface where the bronchus, pulmonary artery and two pulmonary veins enter and leave
縱隔面上的三角形凹陷，支氣管、肺動脈與兩條肺靜脈由此出入
supply: The pulmonary artery lies above and in front, the veins below and in front, the bronchus behind (left lung); the pleura reflects onto these at the root
左肺：肺動脈在上方，肺靜脈在前下方，支氣管在後；胸膜在肺根處反折
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-235.name: Hilum of right lung
origin: Surface of the right lung
右肺表面
course: A depression on the mediastinal surface where the bronchus, pulmonary artery and two pulmonary veins enter and leave
縱隔面上的凹陷，支氣管、肺動脈與兩條肺靜脈由此出入
supply: From above down the order is bronchus, artery, veins on the right (the eparterial bronchus runs above the artery); the pleura reflects onto these at the root
右肺由上到下為支氣管、肺動脈、肺靜脈（上葉支氣管在動脈上方）；胸膜在肺根處反折
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-236.name: Left pulmonary ligament
origin: Mediastinal surface of the lower lobe, below the root of the lung
下葉縱隔面、肺根下方
course: A fold of pleura running down from the root of the lung to the diaphragm and mediastinum
由肺根向下延伸到橫膈與縱隔的胸膜皺褶
supply: Lets the lung root move with breathing; the inferior pulmonary vein lies at its upper end and the ligament is cut in lung surgery
讓肺根隨呼吸移動；下肺靜脈在其上端，肺葉手術時需切開
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-237.name: Right pulmonary ligament
origin: Mediastinal surface of the lower lobe, below the root of the lung
下葉縱隔面、肺根下方
course: A fold of pleura running down from the root of the lung to the diaphragm and mediastinum
由肺根向下延伸到橫膈與縱隔的胸膜皺褶
supply: Lets the lung root move with breathing; the inferior pulmonary vein lies at its upper end and the ligament is cut in lung surgery
讓肺根隨呼吸移動；下肺靜脈在其上端，肺葉手術時需切開
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-238.name: Right C1 spinal nerve
origin: Formed by the union of the ventral and dorsal roots of C1, between the occipital bone and the atlas
由第一頸神經的腹根與背根合成
course: Leaves the vertebral canal, then divides at once into a ventral ramus (to the cervical and brachial plexuses) and a dorsal ramus (to the deep back muscles and the skin of the back of the neck and scalp)
離開椎管後立即分成前支（參與頸神經叢與臂神經叢）與後支（支配深層背肌與後頸、後頭皮膚）
supply: Its ventral ramus contributes to the cervical plexus (C1–C4)
前支參與頸神經叢（C1–C4）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-239.name: Right C2 spinal nerve
origin: Formed by the union of the ventral and dorsal roots of C2, between the atlas and the axis
由第二頸神經的腹根與背根合成
course: Leaves the vertebral canal, then divides at once into a ventral ramus (to the cervical and brachial plexuses) and a dorsal ramus (to the deep back muscles and the skin of the back of the neck and scalp)
離開椎管後立即分成前支（參與頸神經叢與臂神經叢）與後支（支配深層背肌與後頸、後頭皮膚）
supply: Its ventral ramus contributes to the cervical plexus (C1–C4)
前支參與頸神經叢（C1–C4）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-240.name: Right C3 spinal nerve
origin: Formed by the union of the ventral and dorsal roots of C3, between the third cervical vertebra and the one below
由第三頸神經的腹根與背根合成
course: Leaves the vertebral canal, then divides at once into a ventral ramus (to the cervical and brachial plexuses) and a dorsal ramus (to the deep back muscles and the skin of the back of the neck and scalp)
離開椎管後立即分成前支（參與頸神經叢與臂神經叢）與後支（支配深層背肌與後頸、後頭皮膚）
supply: Its ventral ramus contributes to the cervical plexus (C1–C4)
前支參與頸神經叢（C1–C4）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-241.name: Right C4 spinal nerve
origin: Formed by the union of the ventral and dorsal roots of C4, between the fourth cervical vertebra and the one below
由第四頸神經的腹根與背根合成
course: Leaves the vertebral canal, then divides at once into a ventral ramus (to the cervical and brachial plexuses) and a dorsal ramus (to the deep back muscles and the skin of the back of the neck and scalp)
離開椎管後立即分成前支（參與頸神經叢與臂神經叢）與後支（支配深層背肌與後頸、後頭皮膚）
supply: Its ventral ramus contributes to the cervical plexus (C1–C4)
前支參與頸神經叢（C1–C4）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-242.name: Right C5 spinal nerve
origin: Formed by the union of the ventral and dorsal roots of C5, between the fifth cervical vertebra and the one below
由第五頸神經的腹根與背根合成
course: Leaves the vertebral canal, then divides at once into a ventral ramus (to the cervical and brachial plexuses) and a dorsal ramus (to the deep back muscles and the skin of the back of the neck and scalp)
離開椎管後立即分成前支（參與頸神經叢與臂神經叢）與後支（支配深層背肌與後頸、後頭皮膚）
supply: Its ventral ramus contributes to the brachial plexus (C5–T1)
前支參與臂神經叢（C5–T1）

supply: Arteries: lateral thoracic, thoraco-acromial and internal thoracic (medial mammary) branches and the posterior intercostal arteries. Nerves: anterior and lateral cutaneous branches of the 4th–6th intercostal nerves. Lymph: about 75% to the axillary nodes, the rest to the parasternal nodes
動脈：胸外側動脈、胸肩峰動脈、胸廓內動脈（內側乳房支）與後肋間動脈；神經：第四至第六肋間神經的前、外側皮支；淋巴：約 75% 回流腋淋巴結，其餘到胸骨旁淋巴結
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-274.name: Left areola
origin: The pigmented skin circle round the nipple
乳頭周圍有色素的皮膚圓區
course: About 3–4 cm across; contains areolar (Montgomery) glands that lubricate the nipple
直徑約 3–4 公分，含蒙哥馬利腺（乳暈腺）潤滑乳頭
supply: Sensory supply by the 4th intercostal nerve
由第四肋間神經司感覺
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-275.name: Left nipple
origin: Centre of the areola, at the 4th intercostal space in the midclavicular line (in the male and in most women)
乳暈中央，位於第四肋間隙、鎖骨中線（男性與多數女性）
course: The lactiferous ducts open on it; smooth muscle fibres make it erect
輸乳管開口於此；平滑肌使乳頭挺起
supply: Dermatome T4; rich in sensory endings
皮節 T4，感覺神經末梢豐富
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-276.name: Mons pubis
origin: The fatty pad over the pubic symphysis and the pubic bones
恥骨聯合與恥骨上的脂肪墊
course: Covered with pubic hair after puberty; continues into the labia majora
青春期後長出陰毛，向下延續為大陰唇
supply: Ilio-inguinal and genital branches of the genitofemoral nerve; superficial external pudendal vessels
髂腹股溝神經與生殖股神經生殖支；淺層陰部外動脈與靜脈
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-277.name: Right labium majus
origin: Fold of skin and fat from the mons pubis to the perineum, on either side of the vulva
由陰阜延伸到會陰的皮膚與脂肪皺褶，位於外陰兩側

覆蓋小陰唇與陰道前庭，含子宮圓韌帶的末端
supply: Ilio-inguinal, genitofemoral and perineal nerves; labial branches of the internal and external pudendal arteries
髂腹股溝神經、生殖股神經與會陰神經；陰部內、外動脈的陰唇支
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.
Position estimated on a male pelvis (see the note on the vulva)

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-279.name: Right bulb of vestibule
origin: Erectile tissue on each side of the vaginal orifice, deep to the labia minora
位於陰道口兩側、小陰唇深面的勃起組織
course: Joined in front by a narrow band under the clitoris; covered by bulbospongiosus
前方以細帶在陰蒂下方相連；被球海綿體肌覆蓋
supply: Perineal branches of the pudendal nerve; artery of the bulb of the vestibule
陰部神經會陰支；前庭球動脈
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-280.name: Right greater vestibular gland
origin: Pea-sized gland behind each vestibular bulb, deep to the posterior part of the labium majus
位於前庭球後方、大陰唇後部深面的豌豆大小腺體
course: Its duct opens in the groove between the hymen and the labium minus, near the middle of the vestibule
導管開口於處女膜與小陰唇之間的溝，約在前庭中部
supply: Secretes mucus during arousal; blockage causes a Bartholin cyst
性興奮時分泌黏液；導管阻塞形成巴氏腺囊腫
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-281.name: Right crus of clitoris
origin: Ischiopubic ramus, covered by ischiocavernosus
附著於坐骨恥骨支，被坐骨海綿體肌覆蓋
course: Passes forwards and medially to join its fellow and form the body of the clitoris
向前內側走行，與對側會合形成陰蒂體
supply: Dorsal nerve of the clitoris (pudendal nerve); deep artery of the clitoris
陰蒂背神經（陰部神經）；陰蒂深動脈
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-287.name: Clitoris
origin: Erectile organ at the front of the vulva: glans, body and two crura attached to the ischiopubic rami
外陰前方的勃起器官：陰蒂頭、陰蒂體與附著於坐骨恥骨支的兩個陰蒂腳
course: The body bends sharply down under the pubic symphysis; the glans is covered by the prepuce formed by the labia minora
陰蒂體在恥骨聯合下方急轉向下；陰蒂頭被小陰唇形成的包皮覆蓋

陰蒂背神經（陰部神經，S2–S4）；陰蒂背動脈與深動脈

PK-288.name: Vestibule of vagina
origin: The cleft between the labia minora
兩側小陰唇之間的裂隙
course: The urethra opens in front and the vagina behind it; the ducts of the greater vestibular glands open at each side
尿道口在前、陰道口在後；前庭大腺導管開口於兩側

陰部神經（S2–S4）支配
